paragraphs: He is mentioned in Kilayim, chapter 3, end of halakhah 2: “The colleagues said before…” etc.
And in Sanhedrin 51b: “for the father of Shmuel bar Avin taught.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: סה״ב is contextually end of halakhah 2 in Kilayim chapter 3, rather than the old sa’if gloss; corpus is suggested by chapter/halakhah style, not freshly verified. אמרין חבריא קומי is cut off by source וכו׳; no missing addressee is invented.

נא: gives Sanhedrin 51b by convention. The preserved prior Davidson observation explicitly reports אבוה דשמואל בר אבין, supporting the father-of grouping rather than a quasi-name; no fresh check or identification with another Shmuel’s father is claimed. Catalog רבי does not expand the abbreviated heading title, which remains R'.
